name: AOD-9604 with a GH secretagogue
other_components: a growth hormone secretagogue (varies by seller)
used_for: Described by telehealth sources as a fat-loss and body composition stack pairing AOD-9604 with a peptide that stimulates growth hormone release.
summary: This is a category of blend rather than one fixed product: AOD-9604, an unapproved growth hormone fragment, is combined with an unspecified growth hormone secretagogue that varies by seller. No approved product and no combination-specific human study was found. Each component's own page holds the detailed information (AOD-9604 is in the library; the secretagogue depends on the product and may have its own page); formulations vary by seller.

internet_claims.claim: A telehealth company's blog (Meto, which offers compounded medications) lists AOD-9604 combined with a growth hormone axis peptide among popular stacks.

A telehealth company's blog (Meto, which offers consultations and compounded medications) says most peptide stacks have far more marketing momentum than clinical evidence, especially for combinations, and that more experimental stacks call for a more conservative risk posture.

dose.summary: No combination study or approved product was found, so there is no studied dose. Two seller-linked sites describe a three-peptide vial (AOD-9604, CJC-1295 and ipamorelin) with differing daily doses, which is a specific product and not every version of this blend.

items.text: PeptideDosages, a site that links to peptide sellers, describes a three-peptide vial of AOD-9604 6 mg, CJC-1295 3 mg and ipamorelin 3 mg (12 mg total) rather than a two-part blend. It says a dose is 0.10 to 0.20 mL daily, about 200 to 400 micrograms (mcg) of AOD-9604 with 100 to 200 mcg each of CJC-1295 and ipamorelin.
items.label: internet

items.text: Dosage Peptide, a site that links to peptide sellers, describes the same three-peptide 12 mg vial. It says the total blend dose is 400 to 1,200 mcg, increased gradually.
items.label: internet

timing.summary: No study covers timing for this combination. One seller-linked site describes a 12 mg three-peptide vial as injected in the morning or before bed.

items.text: PeptideDosages, a site that links to peptide sellers, describes a three-peptide vial of AOD-9604 6 mg, CJC-1295 3 mg and ipamorelin 3 mg (12 mg total) rather than a two-part blend. It says to inject once daily under the skin, preferably in the morning or before bed.

storage_and_handling.summary: No stability data for a mixed AOD-9604 and secretagogue product was found. Two seller-linked sites describe a pre-mixed three-peptide vial kept refrigerated after mixing with liquid.

items.text: PeptideDosages, a site that links to peptide sellers, describes a three-peptide vial of AOD-9604 6 mg, CJC-1295 3 mg and ipamorelin 3 mg (12 mg total) rather than a two-part blend. It says to refrigerate at 2 to 8 degrees Celsius (35.6 to 46.4 degrees Fahrenheit) and to follow the formulation's own use-by and sterile-handling instructions.
items.label: internet

items.text: Dosage Peptide, a site that links to peptide sellers, describes the same three-peptide 12 mg vial. It says to keep the mixed vial refrigerated at about 2 to 8 degrees Celsius, away from light, and not to freeze it. It also says the CJC-1295 and ipamorelin share one vial, so both are drawn in each dose and cannot be given separately.
items.label: internet

side_effect_groups.title: Online commentary
side_effect_groups.summary: No combination study or reported side effects specific to this blend were found. A telehealth seller says this pairing is a popular stack and also says most stacks have more marketing than clinical evidence.

items.text: Meto, a telehealth company that offers compounded medications, says on its blog that AOD-9604 combined with a growth hormone axis peptide is among popular stacks. The Meto pages checked on 2026-10-02 did not repeat this, so it could not be re-confirmed.
